purpose: Refine alpha/beta around historical optima and assess complete 512-update curves in S3R2/S4R3 neural-reference continuations.
method: A_update = alpha A_ref + beta Delta_A; both centered under the current policy; complete AWAC weights detached
screening: Use exactly the five pre-existing hash-selected seed IDs per cell; run every configuration to 512 updates.

metrics.early_mean: trapezoidal mean success 0..128, original primary metric
metrics.full_mean: trapezoidal mean success 0..512, additional full-horizon tuning criterion
metrics.final: success at update 512, additional endpoint tuning criterion

promotion: Union of top 3 early means, top 3 full means, top 2 final scores, historical incumbent, (1,1), and best positive diagonal by early and full means; deduplicate.
expansion: Run each promoted configuration on all 20 original paired seeds to update 512; reuse completed screening runs.
tie_break: smaller alpha+beta, then alpha, then beta, then ID

selection.joint: Among settings whose 20-seed early, full and final means are each at least the incumbent, maximize full_mean; retain incumbent if none improves.

reporting: Report each objective separately, one constant configuration per complete curve. No checkpoint-wise stitching or seed selection. Preserve old main figures and write separate comparison figures.
inference: Expanded development tuning on the original cohorts; bootstrap intervals describe seed variation, not selection-adjusted or held-out inference.
preservation: Full INITIAL, EARLY and FINAL model/optimizer/RNG checkpoints; all successful, weak and failed candidates retained.
engineering: Reproduce archived first-16-update trajectories, detached coefficient decomposition, finite gradients across grid, bitwise save/restore, and incumbent full-curve agreement.
resource_policy: sdc1; 8 GPUs with two workers per GPU during search; stop on numerical failure or less than 10 GiB free.
runtime_scope: Concurrent search timings, not an isolated computational-cost experiment
